meta.description: One node to add to each bot workflow ('Wecon WA Bot' → account=eyad, 'Wecon WA Bot Dubai' → account=dubai). Paste on the canvas, connect 'WhatsApp Webhook' → 'Forward to CRM Chat', save.

eyad.name: Forward to CRM Chat
eyad.notes: Copies every delivery to the 'WECON · WhatsApp chat inbound' workflow (account=eyad) so the CRM Conversations view sees it. Fire-and-forget: never affects this bot's own flow.

dubai.name: Forward to CRM Chat
dubai.notes: Copies every delivery to the 'WECON · WhatsApp chat inbound' workflow (account=dubai) so the CRM Conversations view sees it. Fire-and-forget: never affects this bot's own flow.
